title: 会话与画布
focus: Main: a real readable conversational thread for Checkout error investigation, message evidence cards and bottom composer; adjacent optional wide canvas open in a split layout illustrating two hypothesis branches and evidence convergence. No application/environment gate on page. Small 对话/画布 view controls. Session rail with3 recent titles. Composer plus button left, model right then send-icon only. No attachments capability promise or 开始工作. Application context appears removable @Checkout chip, snapshot inherited subbranch and selected evidence right details. Show root-question and two evidence nodes, NOT a service resource topology. Avoid crowded DAG, clear connectors.

title: 记忆与上下文
focus: Two tabs 长期记忆 and 会话上下文. Search memories by words + 应用/类型/状态. List title/source/updated/version/owner, one selected verified past incident experience; right details content, source Runbook/incident citations, scope and version history. Historical conversation read-only, long-term archive/edit can be permission-gated. No duplicate environment dropdown, no auto claiming LLM remembers all.

title: Skills
focus: Skill library as clean list, scopes 通用 and 应用专用 visible without compulsory choose application. Search + scope/status, primary 新建 Skill. Rows 发布异常诊断, Redis 排查, K8s 资源核对 with maintainer/version/作用域. Right selected Skill detail shows purpose, read-only tools, instructions, applicability and version. Selection not auto executes, clear applicability. No massive card wall.

title: Prompt 模板
focus: Prompt list with general/workspace and application-specific scope. Search title + 适用范围/维护人. Primary 新建模板. Selected template API错误率分析 opens right editor with title, scope choice 通用 or 指定应用, text with {{application}} {{time_range}} readable syntax, variables, preview and 保存草稿. No forced application before viewing, no template is executed on save.

title: 自动化任务
focus: List recurring bounded read-only巡查 tasks with name,target,last run,next run,enabled and outcome. Primary 新建任务. Right selected task detail shows scope applications, cadence 每30分钟, read-only tools 指标/日志, max work limits, latest findings and 手动查看记录. Clear manual approval needed for recovery; no arbitrary automated shell execution.

title: 资源目录
focus: Inventory table, not realtime monitoring. Search resource name/IP/ID + 类型/关联应用/来源. Primary 添加资源. Rows checkout Deployment, redis-checkout, mysql-orders, vm-ops-01, Kafka. Columns resource name/type, associated app, owner/team, data source, updated. Selected Redis opens right details with identity, app bindings, source connector and last observed time, small 相关资源 list. No fake health/CPU charts. Data ownership provenance clear.

title: 资源关系
focus: CMDB relation graph NOT traffic topology. Main big open canvas few clear nodes: Checkout API application linked to checkout Deployment 部署于, Redis cache 依赖, MySQL orders 依赖; Deployment linked cluster-01 归属于. Different subtle node icons, straight or clean elbow labeled edges, excellent spacing. Search resource and compact 关系类型/1-2跳 toolbar. Selected dependency edge purple opens right card with source,target,type,source 人工登记 or Kubernetes发现,last updated 2026-09-21. No QPS/error/latency. Small legend 声明关系/发现关系, bottom zoom controls. Show 去看调用拓扑 as secondary link, no false real-time claims.

title: 交付中心
focus: Beautiful restrained paused entry only, not pipelinebuilder. Header 交付中心, small 暂缓建设 badge and concise text 流程与使用方式确认后再开放. A minimal single clean lineicon center and 返回工作台 link, plenty intentionalwhite but not hugecards. No pipeline templates,builds,runs,deploycontrols,GitLabdata or futureCIfeatures. This screen preserves visible entry and userpause.

Selected warning workload side detail shows replicas3/4, recent restart event, viewmetrics/logs and sendAgent. Distinguish registered scope from whole fleet, not whole CMDB inventory or all clusters.

Right detail overview/config/events tabs, rolloutrevision,image digest abbreviated,replica status,events, view pods and调查; no direct dangerous oneclick rollback outside approval.

Selected BackOff opens right event context first/lastseen count,source kubelet,resource link, readable message and关联工作负载. No confused incident ownership controls.
